title: `=ls<TAB>`: zsh keeps the word and lists commands, zshrs rewrites the line to the resolved path

observed.notes: zsh completes the command NAME after `=` and lists every command beginning with ls; zshrs performs the `=` expansion and replaces the word with /bin/ls, offering no list at all.
